module_title: Instrument Categories and The Absolute Legends
introduction: In Indian classical music, instruments are broadly classified into 4 categories: 1. Tata (String), 2. Sushira (Wind), 3. Avanaddha (Percussion/Drums), and 4. Ghana (Solid/Metal). At this level, we memorize the absolute legends who frequently appear in exams.

core_concepts.title: Sitar (Tata / String Instrument)
core_concepts.description:
Exponents: **Pt. Ravi Shankar**, Ustad Vilayat Khan, Pt. Nikhil Banerjee.
Key Fact: Pt. Ravi Shankar is India's first Grammy Award winner. He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1999.

core_concepts.title: Tabla (Avanaddha / Percussion)
core_concepts.description: Exponents: **Ustad Zakir Hussain**, Ustad Alla Rakha (Zakir Hussain's father), Pt. Kishan Maharaj, Latif Ahmed Khan.

core_concepts.title: Shehnai (Sushira / Wind Instrument)
core_concepts.description:
Exponents: **Ustad Bismillah Khan**, Ali Ahmed Hussain Khan.
Key Fact: Bismillah Khan famously played the Shehnai at the Red Fort on August 15, 1947. He received the Bharat Ratna in 2001.

core_concepts.title: Flute / Bansuri (Sushira / Wind Instrument)
core_concepts.description:
Exponents: **Pt. Hariprasad Chaurasia**, Pannalal Ghosh.
Key Fact: The flute is one of the oldest and simplest wind instruments, traditionally made from a single hollow shaft of bamboo.

important_entities.name: Pt. Ravi Shankar's Autobiography
important_entities.significance: A highly repeated book and author question in SSC: 'My Music, My Life' is the autobiography of which legendary musician? Answer: Sitar maestro Pt. Ravi Shankar.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
Exam Trap: Students often confuse these two famous Muslim maestros. 
Remember: 
- Ustad Alla Rakha = **Tabla** (He is Zakir Hussain's father). 
- Ustad Bismillah Khan = **Shehnai**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Lord Krishna is also known as 'Hari', and he famously played the flute (Bansuri). Therefore, 'Hari'prasad Chaurasia is directly linked to the Flute.

exam_strategy_tips: The easiest and most repeated question in SSC CHSL/CGL: 'Ustad Bismillah Khan is famous for playing which musical instrument?' Answer: Shehnai.
